description.value: You release a shockwave of protective Force energy in a 15-foot radius centered on yourself. Each creature of your choice in that area must make a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 force damage and being pushed 15 feet away from you on a failed save, or half as much damage and no push on a successful one.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 3
